title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
ABOUT STORD
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.
By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.
With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.
Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.
Stord is building the operating system for the modern supply chain — a unified platform handling Order Management, Warehouse Management, Transportation, and Consumer Experience for brands doing over $10B in commerce annually.
We're standing up a net-new Software Engineer in Test (SET) function — not to take quality ownership away from engineering, but to build the automation infrastructure that enables engineering teams to execute on ownership at scale. Today, E2E coverage, regression testing, API/contract testing, and performance testing all have inconsistent or no systematic owner or methodology — engineers patch these gaps ad hoc, on top of their feature work. This role sits embedded within [Product Group], partnering directly with engineers and EMs who remain accountable for coverage, CI gates, and test strategy. You build the frameworks and AI-assisted tooling that make that accountability sustainable at scale.
This role is for an engineer who thinks about testing as a systems-building problem, not a checklist. You'd rather write the automation that catches a regression before a human ever sees it than manually re-verify a happy-path scenario on every release. If you want to build test infrastructure from the ground up, with real budget and executive sponsorship behind it, this role gives you the mandate to do exactly that.
Why This Role
Your work directly affects release velocity and confidence for a large-scale, high-growth platform. By assisting in the development of net-new frameworks and tests, you'll directly impact the Engineering organization's long-term ability to meet high standards in customer satisfaction.
AI-assisted test generation — turning acceptance criteria into automated scripts — is a live, unsolved problem here, not a vendor tool you're asked to babysit. You'll take a cutting edge approach to automated testing in the 21st century and be encouraged to cultivate and sharpen those skills.
You work alongside a SET Lead defining cross-org framework standards from day one, so you're shaping how quality standards and methodologies land in practice, not just inheriting a rulebook.
You're closing gaps across the entire test pyramid — E2E, regression, contract testing, performance testing — that Stord's own testing charter explicitly flags as unowned today.
What You'll Build
Full-Suite Test Automation
Build and maintain scripts across every layer of the test pyramid: API, integration, end-to-end and load tests.
Partner with PMs to convert their most critical smoke suite user flows into automated coverage
Build Playwright-based E2E suites covering [Product Group]'s golden-path user journeys
Wire test [...] l decisions and trade-offs to engineers, PMs, and stakeholders. You ask good questions and listen well.
Collaborative Approach — You work well with others, give constructive code review feedback, and actively seek input from teammates.
Production Mindset — You prioritize reliability and user impact. You think about failure modes, monitoring, and operational concerns as part of your design process.
Learning Agility — You're comfortable with rapidly evolving AI/ML technologies and tools. You stay current without chasing hype.
Strongly Preferred
Experience building a test automation function from scratch, not just extending an existing one
Experience partnering directly with PMs on acceptance criteria and Golden Path journey definition
Familiarity with coverage tooling and using coverage data to prioritize test investment
Hands-on exposure to AI-assisted test generation tooling specifically, not just general-purpose AI coding assistants
Nice to Have
Experience in e-commerce, logistics, or supply-chain domains
Familiarity with [Shopify / WMS-TMS / billing systems]
Experience with security/dependency scanning tools in CI
What Success Looks Like
30 days: Has audited existing test coverage against [Product Group]'s happy-path / sad-path scenarios, identified the top gaps, provided a test plan, and shipped at least one new automated test into CI.
90 days: Regression test register live and passing threshold criteria is gating releases; contract/API test tooling in place for at least one major service boundary; AI-assisted test generation piloted with at least one team.
6 months: Load/performance test framework in active use by engineers on applicable stories; [Product Group]'s release process clears Stord's Definition of Done quality gates without manual rework surfacing at UAT.

score.why: Senior SDET building net-new test automation function (API, E2E, contract, performance) for supply-chain platform; remote US. Strong fit for senior test engineer, though Playwright/JS stack and e-commerce domain are new.
